title: Vector bundles on singular surfaces and threefolds
description: Research article: Vector bundles on singular surfaces and threefolds
summary: We fully classify vector bundles of critical rank on normal affine surfaces and threefolds over algebraically closed fields via their Chern classes. We also prove existence of rank 2 bundles on threefolds with prescribed first and second motivic Chern classes.
The main input is the motivic filtration on algebraic K-theory: its third piece is generated by smooth closed points and is identified with motivic cohomology by the third Chern class.
